motions.item_title: Motion to go into Closed Session
motions.text: That a closed meeting of the Council be held on November 26, 2025, at approximately 4:30 p.m., in the Waterloo County Room, in accordance with Section 239 of the “Municipal Act, 2001”, for the purposes of considering the following subject matters: Receiving information related to identifiable individuals regarding staffing. Advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose, related to ongoing litigation regarding the 100 Victoria Street encampment.
motions.text_html:
That a closed meeting of the Council be held on November 26, 2025, at approximately 4:30 p.m., in the Waterloo County Room, in accordance with Section 239 of the “Municipal Act, 2001”, for the purposes of considering the following subject matters:

  1. Receiving information related to identifiable individuals regarding staffing.
  2. Advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose, related to ongoing litigation regarding the 100 Victoria Street encampment.

motions.text: That the meeting adjourn at 4:29 p.m.
